standard.summary: 对优化器行为做进阶调整，包括 LoRA+（对 A/B 矩阵用不同学习率）和 RSLoRA 等。
standard.effect: lora_plus 对 LoRA 的 up_proj 使用更高学习率，加速收敛；rs_lora 在 rank-stabilized 模式下调整缩放。
standard.whenToUse: auto 让系统自动判断最适合的策略；lora_plus 在 LoRA 训练中通常有 5-15% 提升。
standard.avoidWhen: 使用非 LoRA 训练（finetune）时自动跳过；lulynx SVD 梯度过滤不会把基础优化器状态降为低秩形状。

optionDescriptions.lulynx_svd_gradient_filter: 把梯度投到低秩子空间再更新,秩与刷新间隔另有两个键;想压梯度噪声、顺带省优化器状态时选它。

standard_en.summary: Advanced adjustments to optimizer behaviour, including LoRA+ (different learning rates for the A and B matrices) and RSLoRA.
standard_en.effect: lora_plus gives the LoRA up_proj a higher learning rate to speed up convergence; rs_lora adjusts the scaling in rank-stabilized mode.
standard_en.whenToUse: auto lets the system pick the strategy that fits; lora_plus usually gains 5-15% in LoRA training.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Skipped automatically on non-LoRA training such as a finetune. The lulynx SVD gradient filter does not reduce the base optimizer state to a low-rank shape.

optionDescriptions.profile_only: Only records a profile; the parameter groups are untouched.
optionDescriptions.lora_plus: LoRA+, where the A and B learning rates can be separated.
optionDescriptions.lulynx_svd_gradient_filter: Projects the gradient into a low-rank subspace before the update; the rank and refresh interval have two keys of their own. Pick it when you want to damp gradient noise and save optimizer state along the way.

advanced.principle: LoRA+ 发现 LoRA 的 down_proj（A 矩阵）和 up_proj（B 矩阵）对梯度的敏感度不同，对 B 使用 2-16x 的学习率可以加速。RSLoRA 调整 alpha/dim 缩放随 rank 变化。lulynx SVD 梯度过滤先做双侧低秩投影，再重构回全形状梯度；它是工程近似，不是 GaLore 的低秩 optimizer-state 维护。
advanced.intervention: 修改 optimizer 构造时的参数分组，对不同 param group 设置不同学习率。
advanced.expectedImpact: LoRA+ 在不增加显存的情况下加速收敛；RSLoRA 在不同 rank 下表现更一致。
advanced.tradeoffs: lulynx SVD 梯度过滤保留全尺寸基础优化器状态，主要改变梯度方向/噪声；需要定期 SVD 重算基，不能宣称 GaLore 的 optimizer-state 显存节省。

advanced_en.principle: LoRA+ observed that LoRA's down_proj (A matrix) and up_proj (B matrix) differ in gradient sensitivity, so using a 2-16× higher learning rate on B accelerates training. RSLoRA adjusts the alpha/dim scaling as rank changes. lulynx SVD gradient filtering first does a two-sided low-rank projection, then reconstructs back to a full-shape gradient; it is an engineering approximation, not GaLore's low-rank optimizer-state maintenance.
advanced_en.intervention: Modifies parameter grouping at optimizer construction, giving different param groups different learning rates.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: LoRA+ accelerates convergence without extra VRAM; RSLoRA behaves more consistently across ranks.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: lulynx SVD gradient filtering keeps full-size base optimizer state and mainly changes gradient direction/noise; it requires periodic SVD re-computation of the basis and cannot claim GaLore's optimizer-state VRAM savings.
